Hi, I’m Ashley.

I fell for UI/UX through prototyping. Whether it’s an app, a brand or the front end of a website, I love the moment a mockup starts to feel like something real you can click through.

I want to be the kind of designer who makes boring things look fun. I care about making products feel simple and usable without being forgettable, and I sweat the visual details that make an interface a pleasure to use.

For my co-op, I’m looking for a team where I can sharpen my technical skills, collaborate closely, find a real community, and get hands-on experience with work that real people use.
